src.file: File:Vincent van Gogh - The Church in Auvers-sur-Oise, View from the Chevet - Google Art Project.jpg

medium.zh: 纸板上油彩、蛋彩与蜡笔
medium.en: Oil, tempera and pastel on cardboard

note.zh:
蒙克在日记里写下缘起：黄昏时他与两位朋友走在奥斯陆峡湾边的路上，天空忽然血红，他停下来，「感到一声穿过自然的无尽呐喊」。所以画中人不是在喊——他是在捂住耳朵，抵挡那声来自世界的尖叫。

栏杆用了极端的透视，把观者硬拽进画面；人物没有性别、没有头发，脸被简化成一个空洞。这幅画有四个版本，其中两幅曾被盗，是二十世纪被复制最多的图像之一。
note.en:
Munch recorded the origin in his diary: walking at dusk beside the Oslo fjord with two friends, the sky turned blood red, he stopped, and "felt an infinite scream passing through nature." The figure is not screaming. It is covering its ears against a scream the world is making.

The railing runs in violent perspective, dragging the viewer bodily into the picture; the figure has no gender and no hair, its face reduced to a hollow. Four versions exist, two of them stolen at different times, and it has become among the most reproduced images of the twentieth century.

look.zh: 注意背景两个走远的人影——他们什么也没听见。
look.en: Note the two figures walking away in the background. They hear nothing.

src.file: File:Edvard Munch, 1893, The Scream, oil, tempera and pastel on cardboard, 91 x 73 cm, National Gallery of Norway.jpg

note.zh:
莫奈在教堂对面租下一间二楼小屋，同时摆开十几张画布，光一变就换一张。三年里他画了三十多幅同一个立面。

主题从来不是建筑，而是空气：同一块石头在正午是奶白色，在黄昏变成橙红与紫罗兰。颜料被堆得极厚，表面粗砺如真的石头风化面。塞尚说莫奈「只是一只眼睛——但天哪，是何等的一只眼睛」。
note.en:
Monet rented a first-floor room opposite the cathedral, set up a dozen canvases at once and swapped them as the light moved. Over three years he painted the same façade more than thirty times.

The subject was never architecture but air: the same stone is cream at noon and orange-violet at dusk. The paint is built up so thickly that the surface weathers like masonry. Cézanne said Monet was "only an eye — but my God, what an eye."

look.zh: 颜料厚得像石头本身的风化面。
look.en: The impasto is thick enough to weather like the stone itself.

src.file: File:Claude Monet - Rouen Cathedral, Facade (Sunset).JPG

note.zh:
塞尚为这个题材画了五个版本，模特是他家乡艾克斯附近的农工。他不要戏剧、不要故事，只要两个人对坐时那种沉重的对称。

两人身体构成一个稳定的三角，中间的酒瓶落在正轴线上，像一根钉子把画面钉住。塞尚说他想「用圆柱、球体和圆锥来处理自然」——立体主义就从这句话出发。2011年，这一系列中的另一幅以据称超过两亿五千万美元的价格成交。
note.en:
Cézanne painted five versions of this subject, using farmhands from around his native Aix. No drama, no anecdote — only the heavy symmetry of two men facing each other.

Their bodies form a stable triangle and the bottle sits on the central axis like a pin holding the picture down. Cézanne said he wanted to "treat nature by the cylinder, the sphere, the cone," and Cubism set out from that sentence. In 2011 another canvas in the series sold for a reported sum above 250 million dollars.

look.zh: 中间那只酒瓶落在正中轴上，像一枚图钉。
look.en: The bottle sits on the exact centre axis, like a pin.

src.file: File:Paul Cézanne, Les joueurs de carte (1892-95).jpg

note.zh:
卡萨特是印象派团体中唯一的美国人，也是仅有的三位女性成员之一。这幅画的构图极其大胆：船身占据整个下半部，划桨男子的黑色背影像一块楔子切进画面，视平线被推到极高，观者仿佛也坐在这条船上。

影响来自浮世绘——1890年她在巴黎看了一场大型日本版画展，此后彻底改变了画法。母亲抱着孩子的姿势松弛而真实，没有一点感伤：卡萨特画了一辈子母子题材，却始终拒绝把它们画成圣像。
note.en:
Cassatt was the only American in the Impressionist group and one of only three women in it. The composition is daring: the boat fills the lower half, the oarsman's black back cuts in like a wedge, and the horizon is pushed so high that the viewer seems to be aboard.

The source is Japanese: she saw a major print exhibition in Paris in 1890 and her work changed permanently. The mother holds the child with a slack, unsentimental accuracy. Cassatt painted mothers and children all her life and consistently refused to make them icons.

look.zh: 视平线被推得极高——你也坐在这条船上。
look.en: The horizon sits very high. You are in the boat too.

src.file: File:Mary Cassatt - The Boating Party - Google Art Project.jpg

note.zh:
英国学院派的绝唱，也是一个奇特的收藏故事：二十世纪中期维多利亚绘画被彻底看轻，这张画一度只值几十英镑，1963年被波多黎各的收藏家买下，从此留在加勒比。

橙红的薄纱是全画的技术核心——莱顿要让织物既透光又有重量，用了大量半透明罩染。右上角画着夹竹桃，一种有毒的植物，暗示睡眠与死亡的邻近。人物蜷成一个近乎完美的圆，正好嵌进方形画布。
note.en:
The last great gasp of British academic painting, and an odd collecting story: mid-twentieth-century taste dismissed Victorian art so completely that this canvas was worth a few pounds, until a Puerto Rican collector bought it in 1963. It has stayed in the Caribbean since.

The orange gauze is the technical heart of the picture — Leighton needed cloth that was both translucent and heavy, built from layer on layer of glaze. Top right, an oleander branch: a poisonous plant, sleep next to death. The figure coils into an almost perfect circle set inside a square.

look.zh: 右上角那枝夹竹桃有毒——沉睡与死亡只隔一层纱。
look.en: The oleander at top right is poisonous. Sleep and death, one gauze apart.

src.file: File:Flaming June, by Frederic Lord Leighton (1830-1896).jpg

artist.zh: 亨利·德·图卢兹-罗特列克

note.zh:
罗特列克几乎住在红磨坊里，把这里的舞者、妓女、酒客当作全部题材。他本人也在画中：背景里那个矮小的身影，旁边是他高大的表兄——他因遗传病双腿停止生长，成年身高不足一米五。

右侧那张被绿光照亮的脸是舞者梅·米尔顿，颜色骇人得像幽灵。这一块曾在二十世纪初被人裁掉（大概觉得太丑），后来又缝回原画。斜切的栏杆、被切断的人物，全是浮世绘与摄影的语法。
note.en:
Lautrec practically lived at the Moulin Rouge and took its dancers, prostitutes and drinkers as his entire subject. He is in the picture: the small figure in the background beside his tall cousin. A genetic condition had stopped his legs growing and he stood under five feet as an adult.

The green-lit face at the right belongs to the dancer May Milton, ghastly enough to read as a ghost. That strip was cut off the canvas in the early twentieth century — presumably as too ugly — and later sewn back on. The slashing diagonal rail and the amputated figures are the grammar of Japanese prints and photography.

look.zh: 背景里那个矮小的身影就是画家本人。
look.en: The short figure in the background is the painter himself.

src.file: File:Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec - At the Moulin Rouge - Google Art Project.jpg

note.zh:
卢梭是巴黎的海关小职员，四十岁才开始画画，从未受过训练，一生被沙龙的行家讥笑。他给家乡市长写信推销这幅画，说它「画的是一个疲惫的曼陀林手在沙漠中沉睡，狮子经过却不吞噬她」。市长没买。

没有阴影、没有脚印、月亮悬在正上方——一切都不合物理，却安静得让人屏息。毕加索在旧货摊上买到一幅卢梭，为他办了一场著名的宴会。超现实主义者视他为先知。
note.en:
Rousseau was a Paris customs clerk who began painting in his forties, never trained, and was mocked by Salon professionals all his life. He wrote to the mayor of his home town offering the picture, describing "a wandering negress, a mandolin player, lies with her jar beside her, overcome by fatigue... a lion chances to pass by and does not devour her." The mayor declined.

There are no shadows, no footprints, and the moon hangs directly overhead. Nothing obeys physics, and the silence is total. Picasso bought a Rousseau from a junk dealer and threw a famous banquet in his honour; the Surrealists treated him as a prophet.

look.zh: 沙上没有脚印，人和狮子都没有影子。
look.en: No footprints in the sand, and neither woman nor lion casts a shadow.

src.file: File:La Bohémienne endormie.jpg

note.zh:
毕沙罗晚年患眼疾，无法长时间在户外作画，于是在蒙马特大道旁的俄罗斯饭店租了一间房，从窗口画同一条街——一个冬春共十四幅，晨昏晴雨各不相同。

这是把「系列绘画」用在城市上的最好例子：不变的是建筑轮廓，变化的是天气、光线和街上的人流密度。毕沙罗是印象派里年纪最长、最慷慨的一位，塞尚、高更、修拉都受过他的指点，他被称为「印象派之父」。
note.en:
Failing eyesight kept the older Pissarro from long spells outdoors, so he took a room at the Hôtel de Russie on the Boulevard Montmartre and painted the same street from the window — fourteen canvases across one winter and spring, in every light and weather.

It is the best case of serial painting applied to a city: the architecture holds still while weather, light and the density of the crowd change. Pissarro was the oldest and most generous of the Impressionists — Cézanne, Gauguin and Seurat all learned from him — and was called the father of the movement.

look.zh: 同一扇窗、同一条街，他画了十四幅。
look.en: One window, one street, fourteen canvases.

src.file: File:Camille Pissarro - Boulevard Montmartre, Spring - Google Art Project.jpg

title.zh: 我们从何处来？我们是谁？我们向何处去？
title.en: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?

note.zh:
高更在塔希提贫病交加，认为这是自己的遗作，画完后曾试图自杀。要从右往左读：右下角的婴儿是「从何处来」，中央摘果的青年是「我们是谁」，左侧蜷缩的老妇是「向何处去」。

他把标题直接写在左上角的黄色块上，像刻在墙上。画布是粗麻布，颜料薄而干涩。这幅画既是高更对西方文明的告别，也无法回避他与殖民地少女关系的伦理问题——观看它时，这两件事同时存在。
note.en:
Painted in Tahiti while Gauguin was ill and destitute; he regarded it as his testament and attempted suicide after finishing it. Read right to left: the infant at lower right is where we come from, the youth picking fruit at the centre is what we are, the crouching old woman at the left is where we are going.

He lettered the title directly onto the yellow field at the top left, as if cut into a wall. The support is coarse burlap and the paint is thin and dry. The picture is Gauguin's farewell to European civilisation, and it cannot be separated from the ethics of his relationships with Tahitian girls. Both things are present when you look.

look.zh: 从右往左读：婴儿、青年、老妇，就是标题的三个问题。
look.en: Read right to left — infant, youth, old woman — and you have the three questions.

src.file: File:Paul Gauguin - D'ou venons-nous.jpg

note.zh:
一个黑人水手躺在断了桅杆的小船上，四周是鲨鱼与正在逼近的水龙卷；左上角远处有一艘船，但它没有转向。霍默拒绝解释结局，藏家追问时他不耐烦地回信：「告诉那些女士，那个可怜人最后被救了，回家了，从此过得很好。」

创作于美国种族暴力最严重的年代之一，今天几乎无法不被读作一则关于黑人处境的寓言。霍默晚年独居缅因海边，画的都是人在自然面前无从谈判的处境。
note.en:
A Black sailor lies on a dismasted boat surrounded by sharks, a waterspout closing in. There is a ship on the horizon at the upper left, and it is not turning. Homer refused to explain the ending; pressed by collectors, he replied irritably that they should be told "the unfortunate negro... will be rescued and returned to his friends and home, and ever after live happily."

Made in one of the worst decades of American racial violence, it is now almost impossible not to read as a parable. Homer spent his last years alone on the Maine coast, painting situations in which nature does not negotiate.

look.zh: 左上角远处有一艘船——它没有转向。
look.en: There is a ship on the horizon at upper left. It is not turning.

src.file: File:Winslow Homer - The Gulf Stream - Metropolitan Museum of Art.jpg

note.zh:
塞尚一生画了六十多幅这座山，从家乡艾克斯的不同角度、不同季节。晚年的版本几乎放弃了轮廓线，山体由一块块并置的色斑构成，每一块都同时属于山和天。

这是绘画史上一个关键的转折：形不再靠线定义，而靠色彩的推挤生成。毕加索和布拉克在1907年前后反复研究这些画，立体主义的碎面结构直接从这里来。塞尚死于1906年，是在户外写生时淋雨受寒。
note.en:
Cézanne painted this mountain more than sixty times, from different angles around Aix and in every season. The late versions abandon contour almost entirely: the mountain is built from patches of colour set side by side, each belonging simultaneously to rock and to sky.

This is a hinge in the history of painting — form generated by the pressure of colour rather than defined by line. Picasso and Braque studied these canvases around 1907, and Cubism's faceting comes straight out of them. Cézanne died in 1906 after being caught in a storm while painting outdoors.

look.zh: 山与天用的是同一批色块——边界被取消了。
look.en: Mountain and sky are made from the same patches. The boundary is abolished.

src.file: File:Paul Cézanne - Mont Sainte-Victoire - Google Art Project.jpg

title.zh: 阿黛尔·布洛赫-鲍尔肖像 I

medium.en: Oil, silver and gold leaf on canvas

note.zh:
「奥地利的蒙娜丽莎」。阿黛尔是维也纳犹太糖业家族的女主人，克里姆特唯一画过两次的模特。金箔几乎吞没了人物，只留下脸、肩与双手是肉体——她的右手其实是变形的，因为一根手指有伤，她习惯这样遮住。

1938年纳粹掠走此画，战后被奥地利国家美术馆当作「奥地利国宝」占有六十年。阿黛尔的侄女玛丽亚·阿尔特曼在美国最高法院打赢官司，2006年画作归还，随即以1.35亿美元售出。
note.en:
"The Austrian Mona Lisa." Adele was the wife of a Viennese Jewish sugar magnate and the only sitter Klimt painted twice. Gold leaf all but swallows the figure, leaving only face, shoulders and hands as flesh — and her right hand is deformed in the picture because an injured finger made her hold it that way.

The Nazis seized the painting in 1938 and post-war Austria kept it for sixty years as a national treasure. Adele's niece Maria Altmann won her case in the US Supreme Court, the painting was returned in 2006, and it sold immediately for 135 million dollars.

look.zh: 她的右手姿势是真的——她在遮一根受伤的手指。
look.en: Her right hand is posed to hide an injured finger. That detail is real.

src.file: File:Gustav Klimt 046.jpg

medium.en: Oil, gold and silver leaf on canvas

note.zh:
克里姆特「黄金时期」的顶点。父亲是金匠，他从小在金箔与錾刻里长大，这幅画把拜占庭马赛克的贴金工艺直接搬到了画布上。

注意两人衣袍上的图案区别：男子是黑白矩形，女子是彩色圆形与花朵——形状的性别隐喻在整个维也纳分离派里都很典型。两人跪在一片开花的悬崖边缘，女子的脚趾蜷曲着扣住崖沿。金色包裹住的，其实是一个不太安稳的时刻。
note.en:
The summit of Klimt's golden period. His father was a gold engraver, and this canvas carries Byzantine mosaic technique — real gold and silver leaf — directly onto painted ground.

Look at how the two robes differ: black-and-white rectangles for him, coloured circles and flowers for her. That gendering of shape runs through the whole Vienna Secession. The couple kneel at the edge of a flowering cliff, and her toes curl over the drop. What the gold encloses is not a safe moment.

look.zh: 看女子的脚——她踩在悬崖边，金色之下是不安。
look.en: Look at her feet: she is at the cliff edge. Anxiety under all that gold.

src.file: File:The Kiss - Gustav Klimt - Google Cultural Institute.jpg

note.zh:
卢梭生前最后一幅大画，同年去世。他从未离开过法国——所有的丛林都来自巴黎植物园的温室和儿童画报。他说自己画的是「雅德维加梦见自己听到蛇人的笛声」。

据数过的人统计，画中有五十多种深浅不同的绿。沙发被原封不动地搬进热带雨林，这种理直气壮的荒谬正是他的力量所在。卢梭去世时贫困潦倒，葬礼只有七个人到场。
note.en:
Rousseau's last large canvas, finished the year he died. He never left France — every jungle he painted came from the greenhouses of the Jardin des Plantes and from children's illustrated papers. He said it showed "Yadwigha, dreaming, hearing the music of the snake charmer's pipe."

People who have counted report more than fifty distinct greens. A drawing-room sofa has been carried unaltered into the rainforest, and that unembarrassed absurdity is exactly his strength. Rousseau died destitute; seven people attended the funeral.

look.zh: 数一数绿色——有人统计出五十多种。
look.en: Count the greens. People who have tried report more than fifty.

src.file: File:Henri Rousseau - Le Rêve - Google Art Project.jpg

title.zh: 艺术家在新伦巴赫的房间

note.zh:
席勒二十一岁时画的自己的房间，构图直接致敬梵高的《阿尔勒的卧室》——他在1906年的维也纳见过梵高的作品，终身念念不忘。

但两者气质完全相反：梵高要「绝对的休息」，席勒的房间冷、瘦、紧绷，家具边缘像被削过。第二年他在新伦巴赫因作品「有伤风化」被捕入狱二十四天，法官当庭焚毁了他的一幅画。他二十八岁死于西班牙流感，妻子先他三天去世。
note.en:
Schiele painted his own room at twenty-one, quoting Van Gogh's Bedroom in Arles directly — he had seen Van Gogh in Vienna in 1906 and never got over it.

The temperaments are opposite. Van Gogh wanted "absolute rest"; Schiele's room is cold, lean and strung tight, the furniture edges pared as if with a blade. The following year he was jailed in Neulengbach for twenty-four days over supposedly indecent drawings, and a judge burned one of his works in court. He died of Spanish flu at twenty-eight, three days after his wife.

look.zh: 这是向梵高《阿尔勒的卧室》的致敬——但冷得多。
look.en: A direct homage to Van Gogh's Bedroom, and far colder.

src.file: File:Egon Schiele 070.jpg

note.zh:
康定斯基自认最重要的作品，为它画了三十多幅习作与草图，正式作画却只用了四天。主题埋在抽象之下：末日、洪水、复活与伊甸园的图像被拆解成漂浮的色块与线条。

他有联觉——听见声音会看见颜色。他把黄色比作尖锐的小号，蓝色比作深沉的大提琴，并在《论艺术的精神》中系统写下这套对应。看这幅画的正确方式或许不是「读」，而是「听」。
note.en:
Kandinsky considered this his most important painting. He made more than thirty studies for it and then executed the canvas in four days. Subjects lie buried beneath the abstraction: apocalypse, flood, resurrection and Eden, dismantled into floating fields and lines.

He had synaesthesia — sounds appeared to him as colours. Yellow he likened to a shrill trumpet, blue to a deep cello, and he set the whole correspondence out in On the Spiritual in Art. The right way to take this picture may not be to read it but to listen to it.

look.zh: 康定斯基有联觉——他把黄色听成小号，蓝色听成大提琴。
look.en: Kandinsky was synaesthetic: yellow sounded like a trumpet, blue like a cello.

src.file: File:Composition VII - Wassily Kandinsky, GAC.jpg

note.zh:
1915年的「0,10」展览上，马列维奇把这幅画挂在房间的上角——那是俄国民居里供奉圣像的位置。他称之为「绘画的零点」：不再表现任何东西，只剩下形状本身。

表面早已龟裂，透过裂缝可以看见下面还有别的图层；2015年的分析发现了两幅被覆盖的构图，以及一行几乎无法辨读的题字。它不是虚无，而是一次清空——之后才有可能重新开始。
note.en:
At the 0,10 exhibition in 1915 Malevich hung this in the upper corner of the room, the place a Russian household reserves for its icon. He called it the zero point of painting: nothing represented, only the shape itself.

The surface has long since crazed, and through the cracks other layers show. Analysis in 2015 found two overpainted compositions beneath, plus a barely legible inscription. This is not nihilism but a clearing — the condition for starting again.

look.zh: 裂缝下面还有两幅被覆盖的画。
look.en: Two earlier compositions lie under the cracks.

museum.zh: 希尔玛·阿夫·克林特基金会

note.zh:
阿夫·克林特在1906年就开始画完全抽象的作品，比康定斯基、马列维奇、蒙德里安都早。她受神智学与降神会影响，认为这些画是「受指引」而作。

她在遗嘱中要求：这批画在她去世后二十年内不得公开。1944年去世，直到1986年才首次展出，直到2018年古根海姆的大展才真正震动艺术史——抽象艺术的起点因此需要重写。《天鹅》系列共二十四幅，从具象的两只天鹅逐步演化为纯粹的几何。
note.en:
Af Klint was making entirely abstract paintings by 1906, earlier than Kandinsky, Malevich or Mondrian. Steeped in theosophy and séance practice, she regarded the works as guided rather than invented.

Her will stipulated that they not be shown for twenty years after her death. She died in 1944; the first exhibition came in 1986, and only the Guggenheim's 2018 retrospective properly shook art history, forcing a rewrite of where abstraction begins. The Swan series runs to twenty-four canvases, moving from two recognisable birds toward pure geometry.

look.zh: 她比康定斯基更早画抽象——但要求死后二十年才准展出。
look.en: She reached abstraction before Kandinsky, and forbade any showing for twenty years after her death.

note.zh:
莫奈晚年在吉维尼挖了一个池塘、种上睡莲、造了一座日本桥，然后用最后三十年反复画它。这批大画完全取消了地平线与岸——画面里只有水面，以及水面上倒映的天空。

他此时已患白内障，视野发黄、细节模糊；1923年手术后他重画了一部分作品。有人认为晚期睡莲的抽象性来自疾病，也有人认为那正是他一生视觉训练的终点。无论如何，1950年代的美国抽象表现主义者把这些画认作了自己的祖先。
note.en:
In his later years Monet dug a pond at Giverny, planted water lilies, built a Japanese bridge, and then spent thirty years painting it. In the largest canvases the horizon and the bank are gone entirely: there is only the water, and the sky reflected in it.

He had cataracts by then — his field yellowed and details blurred — and repainted parts of the work after surgery in 1923. Some read the abstraction of the late lilies as pathology; others as the end point of a lifetime's visual training. Either way, the American Abstract Expressionists of the 1950s claimed these paintings as an ancestor.

look.zh: 没有岸、没有地平线——画面只剩水与水中的天。
look.en: No bank, no horizon: only water and the sky inside it.

title.en: Composition II in Red, Blue, and Yellow

note.zh:
蒙德里安称自己的方法为「新造型主义」：只用水平线、垂直线、三原色与黑白灰。他相信剥掉一切偶然之后，剩下的是宇宙的基本秩序。

近看会发现，黑线并不是等宽的，红色块也不是正方形——所有比例都经过反复调整，画面的平衡靠的是「不对称的平衡」。他画画时会把胶带贴在画布上试位置，一试就是几个月。这套语言后来渗透进建筑、平面设计、时装（伊夫·圣罗兰1965年的蒙德里安裙）与网页布局。
note.en:
Mondrian called his method Neoplasticism: horizontals, verticals, the three primaries, plus black, white and grey. He believed that once everything accidental was stripped away, what remained was the underlying order of the universe.

Up close the black lines are not of equal width and the red field is not square. Every proportion has been adjusted and readjusted, and the balance is asymmetrical by design. He worked with tape on the canvas, testing positions for months. The language later leaked into architecture, graphic design, fashion (Saint Laurent's Mondrian dress of 1965) and page layout.

look.zh: 黑线并不等宽，红块也不是正方形——平衡是算出来的。
look.en: The black lines are unequal and the red is not square. The balance is calculated.
